newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel, Powerfin merger been studied -SGB.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel, Powerfin merger been studied -SGB.

text.p: Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB) said on Tuesday a merger of its utility unit Tractebel and Tractebel's unit Powerfin had been considered, but no decision had been taken.

"This issue (of the merger) has indeed been studied. We must now see how this evolves. No decision has been made," SGB chief executive officer Etienne Davignon told a news conference in reply to a question.
Any further news on this would have to come from Tractebel, not from SGB, he added.
Tractebel is a diversified utility group. It is the main shareholder in Electrabel which has a virtual monopoly position in energy production in Belgium.

Davignon made his comments at a news conference where he announced that SGB planned to buy 24.47 percent in Tractebel from rival Belgian holding Groupe Bruxelles Lambert SA (GBL) for 49 billion Belgian francs.
After the transaction SGB will hold 65 percent in Tractebel.
It now has 40 percent in the energy and engineering holding company which controls the country's gas and electricity distribution companies as well as holding energy interests around the world.
Powerfin spearheads the Tractebel group's expansion drive abroad in the electricity sector.
